This vertical rectangular editorial illustration features a teal-blue background. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is positioned between a red rectangle and a large "55". Text above "TEMPO" reads "Obligasi Negara Tak Laris Manis H.76" and "Panggung Wisata Tembok Jokowi H.68". Below it is "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU".

Centrally, a person wearing a green long-sleeved shirt, dark teal sarong, and black peci cap stands in profile, facing left with hands clasped. The figure stands on a horizontal teal line. Below this line, green roots extend downwards from the person’s feet into a dark teal field.

To the left, gray text reads "Laporan Khusus Lebaran", followed by large brown text "IJO ROYO-ROYO PESANTREN HIJAU". Below is smaller black text: "Sejumlah pesantren mengintegrasikan ajaran Islam dengan pengetahuan ilmiah untuk menjaga lingkungan. Kiai dan santri menjadi garda depan merespons perubahan iklim. H24".

The bottom left contains white text: "16-22 MARET 2026", "RP 60.000", "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", "ISSN: 0126 - 4273", alongside a barcode and QR code.
